evals.name: generate-sovereign-ai-workbook
evals.prompt: Create a complete, valid CSF workbook JSON document for an assessment of Sovereign Generative AI infrastructure. Cover confidential GPU computing, private model weight protection, and regional model inference hosting.
evals.expected_output: A valid CSF workbook JSON adhering to schemaVersion 2.0 with objective weights summing to exactly 100 (R1), declared roles, monotonic ladders (R22/R23), and passing all R1-R23 relational invariants.

evals.name: add-party-scoped-question
evals.prompt: Add a new party-scoped question to the legal jurisdiction objective in this workbook that evaluates whether cloud providers are subject to extraterritorial CLOUD Act warrants.
evals.expected_output: An updated workbook containing the new question with scope 'party', axis 'party', monotonically ascending ladder points and SEAL tags, valid declared role LEG, and passing validation.

evals.name: diagnose-and-fix-broken-workbook
evals.prompt: This workbook fails validation because objective weights total 90 instead of 100 and a question ladder drops in points at rung 2. Diagnose and fix the violations.
evals.expected_output: A repaired workbook where objective weights sum to exactly 100 (R1) and ladder points are monotonically non-decreasing (R22), passing validate-workbook.mjs with 0 issues.
